population.span: 18,624 patients admitted to the hospital with an acute coronary syndrome, with or without ST-segment elevation.

endpoint.span: the primary end point--a composite of death from vascular causes, myocardial infarction, or stroke

analysis_set.span: Intention To Treat (ITT) analysis of whole population. Events were adjudicated by an endpoint committee. | TIME FRAME: Randomization up to 12 months | POPULATION: The population was the full analysis set, which included all randomized patients

treatment_strategy.span: In this multicenter, double-blind, randomized trial, we compared ticagrelor (180-mg loading dose, 90 mg twice daily thereafter) and clopidogrel (300-to-600-mg loading dose, 75 mg daily thereafter)

follow_up.span: At 12 months, the primary end point

entry_population_matches_question.why: The abstract describes patients hospitalized with ACS; registry eligibility confirms adults, and the primary composite uses the whole-population ITT analysis.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Inclusion Criteria: * Male or female 18 years or older who has been hospitalised for chest pain and potential ACS

notes: Registry spans support analysis set and adult eligibility. The abstract supplies the composite endpoint, HR, confidence interval, assigned regimens and 12-month timepoint.
